Portfolio.headline: Frontend for real products.
Portfolio.intro: I’m {name}, a software engineer focused on web frontend. I build interfaces with React, Next.js, and TypeScript at Itaú Unibanco, with experience at Carrefour and Sam’s Club Brazil. My backend experience helps me connect those interfaces to the services behind them.
Portfolio.experienceIntro: I work across interfaces and backend systems in product teams. Here are some of my contributions to production applications.
Portfolio.itauContext: At Itaú Unibanco, I develop and support the app’s navigation hub, connecting the user experience to backend integrations.
itauPoints: I rebuilt a frontend workflow in WebView that was previously maintained in Swift and Kotlin repositories.
I implemented local backend caching and contribute to the visual modernization of this experience.
I contribute to an internal tool for specification-driven development with AI agents, skills, and MCP.
Portfolio.carrefourTitle: From member registration to recurring payments.
Portfolio.carrefourContext: At Carrefour and Sam’s Club Brazil, I worked on interfaces and integrations for member registration and payment processes.
carrefourPoints: I built the Sam’s Club member registration flow, from the interface to Node.js endpoints and backend integration on VTEX.
I implemented automation to support recurring payment processes.
I contributed to maintaining and improving React interfaces and APIs.
Portfolio.talst: At Talst Contabilidade, I built systems and automated processes with React, Node.js, NestJS, and Python, applying web development to the company’s day-to-day workflows.
Portfolio.projectsIntro: Projects I built to explore programming, reading, and mindfulness, alongside other web experiences. You can try each one and explore the source code.
Portfolio.aboutTitle: Care for the experience and what powers it.
Portfolio.aboutBody: My focus is on interfaces: how people navigate, understand, and use a product. I work on accessibility, service integration, and maintaining production applications. Backend experience complements that work, helping me understand data flows and the decisions that shape what appears on screen.
Portfolio.contactBody: If your team needs someone focused on web frontend with experience in integrations and backend development, let’s talk about your product challenges and the opportunity.
